scope: Full 1502-frame hard set: SuperPoint+LightGlue candidates replacing the DINOv2 patch matcher, then the same GT-free independent LiDAR geometric verification, then GT-offline comparison of the tiered rule and the fallback-relative rule
cohort: frozen historical V7 epoch10 T>0.5m 1502 frames

matcher.image_pipeline: identical to the frozen four-frame run: RGB, ROTATE_270, longest edge <=560 bicubic, centre crop to multiple of 14
matcher.association: nearest LiDAR return in model-pixel space, keep if distance <= 3.5 px
matcher.dedup: one correspondence per query keypoint, highest LightGlue score wins

observability.note: label-free LiDAR travel-axis observability; reads only the frame's own raw scan, no pose and no GT and no error label
observability.statistic: share of planarity-weighted surface-normal energy along each body axis

query_depth.note: feasibility of Query-side ray casting: project the frame's own scan into the camera (pose-free, both live in the body frame) and read a depth for every SuperPoint keypoint from the nearest projected return; no GT, no estimate pose
query_depth.statistic: count of keypoints with a projected return inside the model-pixel radius, and of those how many have |normal dot ray| >= incidence_min

aggressive.note: aggressive reselection: several correspondence candidates per query keypoint across the provider references, reselected by pose-free cross-side rigid invariants; no GT and no estimated pose is an input to the selection
aggressive.solver: frozen LEADER backend models/sc2pcr.py Matcher.estimator on 3D-3D correspondences, same parameters as run_mink.py (inlier_threshold=2.0, d_thre=2); source is this frame's ray-cast body 3D, target is the reference scan's real world 3D

label_yield.note: label yield for LiDAR-reprojection 2D-2D supervision; uses only the library's own mapping poses on the four training dates, no test GT

label_dataset.note: materialise the LiDAR-reprojection supervision as (query keypoint index, reference keypoint index) pairs; pairing score is the number of labels surviving all checks

lightglue_finetune.note: step 5: fine-tune LightGlue on the LiDAR-reprojection supervision with SuperPoint frozen; unlabelled keypoints are ignored rather than treated as no-match, because most of them do have a true correspondence that this construction could not resolve
lightglue_finetune.version_definition: V8 = LightGlue fine-tuned on LiDAR-reprojection 2D-2D supervision with SuperPoint frozen; supervision labels come from ground-truth poses plus LiDAR reprojection and never from LightGlue output; unlabelled keypoints are ignored rather than treated as no-match

label_dataset_hard.note: labels for the 1502 hard frames, split by DATE because adjacent frames on one date see the same road; the query side is a hard frame with its own scan and ground-truth pose, the reference side is exactly the deployed provider list

rules.tiered: candidate must pass geometry_verified AND be directionally observable, else keep the frozen V7 baseline output
rules.relative_v7: per frame take the highest-scoring candidate; accept it iff its GT-free score exceeds the score of that frame's frozen V7 output; else keep the V7 output
rules.relative_v7_margin_0.1: same as relative_v7 but the candidate must exceed the V7 score by at least 0.1
rules.relative_sc2: same but compared against the raw SC2 initial, which is the weaker bar and is reported only for continuity with the four-frame study
rules.note: the pipeline's real fallback is SC2 followed by V7 refinement, so the frozen V7 output is the pose a rule has to beat
